comparison.objective: Guide a plasma torch along a straightedge to sever plate and drop an offcut; candidate physically sieves a mixed loose-body load.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual straightedge stabilization and speed-controlled cutting versus two-tab load sharing, orientation-sensitive sifting, and spill-limited agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Sound cut segments, free offcut, safe clearance, and returned tools versus recovered media fraction, retained washers, reseated screen, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual force control is generic; cutting quality and material separation through apertures are meaningfully different tested abilities. Missing rubric details: none material.
